demo-breakdown.message: Cached run of the technique pipeline on Ma Long's forehand Short (youtube.com/shorts/g3n9jVP0fMU). Stroke type auto-detected from the swing: forehand loop vs backspin.

breakdown.headline: Get low. Lift the backspin.
breakdown.grip: Shakehand, loose in the backswing so the wrist can add brush.
breakdown.stance: Wide base with deep knee bend (knees ~123 deg).
breakdown.swing_path: Start below the table edge and swing steeply up, brushing up the back of the ball.
breakdown.contact_point: Ball met low, near hip height, in front of the body, elbow open to ~146 deg.
breakdown.follow_through: High finish above the head; the legs push you back up.

steps.title: Drop low
lines: Knees bend, bat below the table.

steps.title: Lift steep
lines: Swing up the back of the ball.
Let it drop after the peak.

steps.title: End above
lines: Legs push you back to ready.

breakdown.recap: Drop low, lift steep, end above.
breakdown.drill: Have a partner push long and loop 10 in a row.
